usedFor: JustCall holds calls and texts, and Google Docs receives the call text through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Call Updated” in JustCall, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Call notes arrive as text, so they land in a document tab as a written record of the call.

watchOut: “Call Updated” in JustCall fires on note edits, so the same call can write to the tab more than once.
